summary: Completed comprehensive testing of multi-tenant school management system. Backend APIs are fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend authentication, navigation, and core features working correctly. Fixed critical backend datetime comparison bug and frontend registration role issue.

fixed_issues.issue: DateTime comparison error in session validation
fixed_issues.fix: Added proper datetime parsing for ISO string format
fixed_issues.impact: Was causing 500 errors on all authenticated endpoints

integration_issues.issue: CORS policy warnings in browser console but functionality works

fixed_issues.issue: Hardcoded 'school_admin' role without school_id causing registration failures

Frontend: Auth dialog opens and functions
Frontend: Dashboard loads with role-based stats
Frontend: Role-based navigation (super admin sees Schools menu)
Frontend: Schools page displays existing schools
Frontend: School creation via UI form
Frontend: Navigation between pages (Dashboard, Schools, Announcements, Profile)
